rules: Primitive is implementation material, not a user-facing workflow.
Component is a bounded reusable unit with local anatomy, state, accessibility, and API.
Pattern coordinates multiple components, data, policy, validation, recovery, routing, or responsive orchestration.
Template proves one or more patterns in a complete product shell or domain surface.
Docs may demonstrate taxonomy decisions but must not promote a forbidden component artifact.

decisions.reason: Persistent alert aggregation is feedback orchestration; Toast, Error Panel, Badge, Button, and Notification Panel own the reusable parts.
Bottom Sheet is a 100% mobile overlay pattern with focus, dismissal, drag/state, and responsive orchestration beyond a bounded component.
Checkbox remains atomic; group label, select-all, mixed state, shared validation, and analytics are pattern-owned.
Radio Button remains atomic; exclusive group question, shared name, arrow navigation, validation, and layout are pattern-owned.
Avatar remains atomic; overflow, stacking, disclosure, permissions, and member detail are pattern-owned.
Table remains the component; sorting, filtering, pagination, column config, remote loading, and bulk actions belong to data-table patterns.
Filter bars coordinate query state, dependencies, saved views, refresh, and dashboard feedback.
Driver table behavior includes invite, suspend, edit, audit, permissions, and remote data operations.
Vehicle table behavior includes assignment, maintenance metadata, document state, grouping, and lifecycle.
Sorting usually belongs to table/list state, persistence, refresh, and result feedback.
Legend items are chart interaction patterns; they must not be promoted as standalone components.

Configuration Console is an administrative product surface that composes Topbar, Sidebar, Roles and Permissions, Driver and Vehicle Administration, and Authentication patterns with data, permissions, audit, and recovery ownership.
Driver Card Wallet is a focused product surface for card status, movement evidence, limits, quick actions, and support recovery; it must compose modules and patterns rather than becoming a component.
Driver Mobile App is a complete mobile product shell that proves onboarding, card readiness, nearby stations, and support recovery across mobile states and permissions.
Fleet Dashboard Suite is a multi-domain dashboard product surface that preserves shared filters, navigation, thresholds, drill-downs, and accountability across operational domains.
Fleet Manager Desktop is a desktop operating console that coordinates overview, exceptions, activity, filters, permissions, and follow-up across multiple patterns.

Routes and Stations is a mobile workspace that proves map/list station discovery, selected station detail, permissions, fallback, and route handoff through approved pattern and primitive dependencies.
Agent Workspace is a complete service workspace template that coordinates queue, thread, composer, context evidence, handoff, and recovery through governed chat components and feedback patterns.
Internal Operations Console is a desktop operations shell that proves case, ticket, account, pricing, approval, and growth workflows across governed patterns.
Settings Workspace is a complete product settings surface that coordinates sections, preferences, validation, theme, and danger-zone confirmation through governed patterns.

requiredBoundaryCases.reason: Accessibility is a governing foundation, not a component prop bundle.
State defines semantic behavior across components and patterns.
Tone governs feedback language before primitives render it.
Depth is a foundation for hierarchy and elevation semantics.
Frame governs composition and layout rhythm.
Voice governs content decisions across UI layers.
Momentum governs motion intent before primitive curves implement it.
Surface is the grouping primitive; Card must not become the default wrapper for pattern groups.
Spacing is a primitive consumed by components and patterns through cascade.
Radius is a primitive token contract, not per-demo styling.
Typography is a primitive contract for text rendering.
Color is a primitive token contract.
Density must cascade through Flow primitives before pattern layout adapts.
Elevation implements depth decisions as a primitive.
Focus is a primitive interaction affordance shared by components and patterns.
Loading is a primitive state vocabulary, not a one-off pattern style.
Disabled is a primitive state vocabulary.
Field action is the primitive affordance inside field-like components and patterns.
Maps are primitive infrastructure for station and route patterns.
Charts are primitive visualization infrastructure for chart patterns and templates.
Breakpoints are responsive primitives, not docs CSS behavior.
Card remains a bounded component, not a generic pattern container.
Table remains the base component; remote state and tools belong to patterns.
Dialog owns the modal primitive behavior that overlay patterns compose.
Drawer owns base panel behavior; adapters and sheets remain patterns.
Popover owns anchored overlay behavior.
Menu owns command list behavior used by pattern menus.
Toast is a bounded feedback component; providers and panels are patterns.
Checkbox remains atomic; group semantics are pattern-owned.
Radio Button remains atomic; group semantics are pattern-owned.
Avatar remains atomic; disclosure and overflow are pattern-owned.
Search coordinates input, results, empty states, shortcuts, and async behavior.
Topbar coordinates navigation, search, account menu, notifications, and responsive shell state.
Toolbar coordinates command groups, filters, selection, and layout priority.
Avatar menu composes Avatar, Menu, permissions, and account actions.
Notification panel orchestrates feedback components and persistent alert state.
Action sheet is a mobile interaction pattern over overlay components.
Fullscreen sheet is responsive overlay orchestration.
Roles and permissions is business/state orchestration, not a table component.
Virtual data table owns remote data, virtualization, selection, and table tooling.
Provider behavior belongs above Toast as a pattern.
Drawer adapter maps responsive workflow behavior onto Drawer.
Confirmation dialog composes Dialog with destructive action workflow.
Autocomplete coordinates async suggestions, filtering, and input behavior.
Multi-select coordinates selection state across components.
Filter chip group coordinates query state and removable filters.
Configuration Console is a product surface template.
Driver Card Wallet is a product surface template.
Driver Mobile App is a product surface template.
Fleet Dashboard Suite is a product surface template.
Fleet Manager Desktop is a product surface template.
Routes and Stations is a product surface template.
Alert strip must resolve to feedback orchestration instead of becoming another component.
Checkbox group is pattern state around atomic Checkbox.
Radio group is pattern state around atomic Radio Button.
Bottom sheet remains mobile overlay orchestration.
Data table resolves to the Virtual Data Table pattern, not Table component inflation.
Sort control belongs to toolbar/list state orchestration.
Chart legend item remains chart interaction pattern.
